Privatisation To increase participation of private sector in the public
sector companies by capital investment or by management or both
or to hand over public sector unit to private company is called
Privatisation.
Liberalisation Liberalisation is the process by which government
control is relaxed or abolished_ In this process privatisation is also
included.
